capabilities.nativeFeature: Portable Agent Plugins and repository marketplaces
capabilities.localOverlap: Direct pack projection remains necessary for REPO and IDE discovery during migration.
capabilities.action: Pilot one bounded frontend-design plugin and preserve direct discovery without simultaneous duplicate installation.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Existing sessions refresh installed plugin tools, skills, and hooks after external plugin upgrades or rollbacks
capabilities.localOverlap: A framework watcher or session-reload hook would duplicate native extension refresh and could inject stale context.
capabilities.action: Use native plugin refresh. Global guidance remains run-scoped; validate effective target and installed source identity. Install from clean detached Git by default, development links only by explicit opt-in; no reload watcher.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Scheduled tasks, monitors, reminders, and later follow-up
capabilities.localOverlap: Repository pollers, retry daemons, and lifecycle hooks would duplicate native scheduling.
capabilities.action: Route explicitly recurring work to native automations and keep repository workflow engines absent.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Task names, pins, sections, handoff, history-backed forks, native task dashboards, and queued task messages
capabilities.localOverlap: Local task registries, message queues, status dashboards, fork wrappers, and handoff files duplicate native task state and coordination.
capabilities.action: Use a fork only for an explicitly requested history-backed alternative, a new task for independent context, and a subagent for bounded current-request work; keep parallel writers in separate worktrees and use native task messaging and management.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Codex doctor endpoint-protection, network, desktop, update, storage, and runtime diagnostics
capabilities.localOverlap: Reimplementing provider, desktop, update, or runtime health probes in framework scripts would drift from the native diagnostic surface.
capabilities.action: Delegate platform diagnostics to native codex doctor and keep framework-doctor limited to framework installation, ownership, prompt, pack, hook, and evidence checks.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Resume and fork restoration of persisted working directory and active permission profile with configured-default resolution when persisted state is invalid
capabilities.localOverlap: A framework permission override would hide the native effective profile, while assuming restoration always succeeds could continue consequential work with broader configured defaults.
capabilities.action: After resume or fork, verify the effective working directory and permission profile before consequential work; stop on mismatch and never treat default resolution as authorization for broader access.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Asynchronous hooks and hook-initiated MCP tool calls
capabilities.localOverlap: Legacy shell parser and hook installer duplicated native approvals and rejected valid user branch intent.
capabilities.action: Remove the parser and installer. Keep approval decisions native; no hook routes lifecycle, waiting or challenge.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Configurable native skill-catalog token budget and recent or character-routed skill selection
capabilities.localOverlap: A framework-side skill prompt injector or router would duplicate native discovery and selection.
capabilities.action: Keep the native catalog default while prompt-input evidence shows complete core discovery without truncation; change the native budget only from measured catalog pressure, never add a local router.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Read-only shared snapshots of local Codex threads
capabilities.localOverlap: A framework transcript exporter or auto-share workflow could expose sensitive history and would duplicate native snapshot controls and revocation.
capabilities.action: Use native sharing only on explicit request after reviewing the snapshot audience and content; never auto-share, and keep export or redaction wrappers absent.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Complete TUI conversation export to Markdown or the clipboard with /export
capabilities.localOverlap: Automatic transcript export or a framework exporter could disclose prompts, tool output, credentials, or proprietary context and would duplicate native export controls.
capabilities.action: Export only on explicit user request after reviewing the exact destination and transcript content; never auto-export or treat native secret-pattern handling as complete disclosure review.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Visible Browser with DOM, console, network, runtime, and profiling evidence
capabilities.localOverlap: Browser reset wrappers and silent headless acceptance duplicate or weaken native Browser control.
capabilities.action: Start visible interactive UI verification early and retain headless checks only as supplemental regression evidence.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Record and Replay for demonstrated Computer Use workflows
capabilities.localOverlap: A repository recorder or browser macro would bypass native consent and availability gates.
capabilities.action: Offer only after a user demonstrates a repetitive workflow; never enable or simulate recording automatically.

capabilities.nativeFeature: GitHub integration, codex review, and approval review
capabilities.localOverlap: General PR wrappers and an always-on custom reviewer duplicate native review surfaces. Native custom-agent discovery does not reliably load symlinked TOML profiles from the personal agents directory.
capabilities.action: Use native review for routine work and reserve one read-only custom reviewer, spawned without inherited conversation history and given only a neutral evidence bundle, for high-risk falsification. Install framework profiles as collision-safe managed regular files and verify their content through the effective-state doctor.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Automatic approval review through --approve-for-me
capabilities.localOverlap: Framework-side auto-approval would weaken native sandbox and approval ownership.
capabilities.action: Use only when already enabled by the user for an eligible run; never set it from repository policy.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Native subagent lifecycle, model catalog, concurrency, and steering
capabilities.localOverlap: Custom depth routing, forced routine model effort, and lifecycle hooks overrode native ownership.
capabilities.action: Remove the undocumented depth override and routine tester effort pin; retain only narrow architect/reviewer judgment profiles.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Native desktop and CLI import for supported agent setup and recent work
capabilities.localOverlap: A framework importer or conversation migration wrapper would duplicate native import and risk stale or duplicate state.
capabilities.action: Use native import only when the user chooses migration from a supported agent; keep repository bootstrap focused on tracked project configuration.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Opt-in Computer History as a desktop recall and timeline source
capabilities.localOverlap: Memories or activity history cannot safely replace required repository instructions or current provider-visible environment identity.
capabilities.action: Allow Computer History only when natively available and user-enabled; treat it as optional recall and keep durable project authority in tracked instructions.

capabilities.nativeFeature: ChatGPT desktop app preview for supported Linux distributions
capabilities.localOverlap: The framework's shared Desktop and CLI configuration contract remains valid while individual native capabilities vary by surface.
capabilities.action: Preserve one project configuration across surfaces and report unavailable Linux-preview capabilities explicitly instead of adding framework fallbacks.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Stable request compression, remote compaction v2, skill search, cached web search, prompt caching, MCP catalog caching, and provider token telemetry
capabilities.localOverlap: Local cache, transcript replay, prompt injection, compaction, or tool-catalog wrappers would duplicate native ownership and could hide actual provider usage.
capabilities.action: Leave stable optimizations at native defaults, bound retained tool output as an evidence-backed local preference, keep auto-compaction model-owned, and separate prompt input, raw rollout output, and provider token telemetry in the token budget gate.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Experimental rollout token budgets and reminders
capabilities.localOverlap: Deterministic framework byte and configuration budgets cover repository-owned prompt surfaces but cannot replace provider-owned total rollout accounting.
capabilities.action: Keep the preview feature disabled, use stable raw usage events and prompt-input diagnostics, and reconsider native rollout enforcement only after it becomes stable.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Per-MCP-tool output token limits and structured MCP errors
capabilities.localOverlap: A framework MCP truncation proxy would duplicate native per-tool limits and obscure the provider error boundary.
capabilities.action: Use native per-tool output_token_limit only when measured output pressure justifies it; preserve structured MCP errors and do not add a proxy.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Stable maintenance release with no separately documented framework-relevant behavior
capabilities.localOverlap: Inventing a local action for a release whose notes contain only a comparison link would fabricate a capability delta.
capabilities.action: Record the release as reviewed and retain the prior framework decisions without manufacturing an adoption claim.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Native planning tool availability is configuration and surface dependent
capabilities.localOverlap: A local plan file or shell planner would duplicate native goals and plans when the tool is available.
capabilities.action: Use native goals or plans when exposed, continue directly when they are not, and never create a repository plan surrogate.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Asynchronous request_user_input while compatible model and tool surfaces are available
capabilities.localOverlap: A polling prompt or background question queue would duplicate native question delivery.
capabilities.action: Use the native question tool only when it is actually exposed; otherwise ask directly at a real stop boundary without inventing an async layer.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Experimental context-management mode
capabilities.localOverlap: Enabling an under-development context manager or recreating it locally would weaken native stability and evidence retention.
capabilities.action: Keep experimental context management disabled until it is stable; use native production compaction and compression defaults.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Native model catalog and default-model updates including Astra visibility
capabilities.localOverlap: A project model pin or framework model router would prevent automatic native default adoption and become stale.
capabilities.action: Keep repository and ordinary profiles unpinned. Treat any user-owned global model pin as an explicit external choice and report that it overrides new native defaults without rewriting it.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Native plugin CLI with local and remote marketplace install, list, update, and removal flows
capabilities.localOverlap: A framework-specific plugin installer or duplicated hooks-only distribution would compete with native plugin lifecycle ownership.
capabilities.action: Use native plugin marketplace commands for plugin lifecycle. Retain setup only for global instructions, profiles, and direct project packs that native plugins do not own.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Daybreak Blue and separately approved Daybreak Red security access tiers
capabilities.localOverlap: Security skills must not choose restricted models, infer offensive authorization, or recreate trusted-access policy.
capabilities.action: Use an approved native tier only inside the exact authorized engagement; Blue approval does not grant Red, and model/access provisioning remains user, workspace, and organization owned.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Python SDK 0.154.0 ExternalMessage, per-turn options, history selection and typed notifications
capabilities.localOverlap: Framework validators invoke native Codex CLI; no Python SDK transport, HookMetadata access or event-history replay implementation exists locally.
capabilities.action: Keep native CLI ownership. ExternalMessage carries tool authority rather than user authorization; include_turns selects returned history rather than model context. Do not add SDK event or replay wrappers. SDK users must respect typed payloads and partial late-attached streams.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Cygwin Windows voice build-input and corresponding-source archives
capabilities.localOverlap: Upstream CI-only build inputs are not user runtime packages and have no local framework voice-build counterpart.
capabilities.action: Retain native runtime installation; do not install CI-only Cygwin artifacts or create a voice toolchain from release-list presence.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Native tester/architect/reviewer agents and worktrees
capabilities.localOverlap: Global challenge, worktree isolation and acceptance criteria use native delegation without a lifecycle engine.
capabilities.action: Automatically challenge substantive work; require executable rebuttal and exact merge evidence. Review caps do not block authorized CI repair.

capabilities.nativeFeature: September 14 GPT-5.5 retirement notice for October 14, 2026
capabilities.localOverlap: No gpt-5.5 pin found in active framework source; user configuration remains external authority.
capabilities.action: Retain native model selection; report and migrate external pins only within user-authorized model migration.

capabilities.nativeFeature: Named permission profiles extending the native read-only profile with explicit filesystem roots
capabilities.localOverlap: Delivery evaluation used legacy workspace-write settings and ambient temporary-directory write roots, which did not provide an independently tested collector boundary.
capabilities.action: Use a task-scoped native profile for disposable evaluation only: fixture area writable, remaining filesystem read-only, command network disabled. The native macOS sandbox probe confirmed the permitted write and denied an adjacent collector write; do not claim equivalent OS enforcement on untested platforms.
